items.prompt: What does a jthread stop request guarantee?

options.text: The OS forcibly kills the worker immediately
The stop state is requested; worker behavior controls completion
options.why: The fixed bounded workers finish without needing a stop check.

options.text: A blocked worker always finishes before a fixed deadline
options.why: Join can wait indefinitely if the worker does not finish.

items.explanation: Joining/lifetime ownership is different from guaranteed cancellation latency.
